description: This Java class 'UtilCache' provides a generalized caching utility with features like size limits, expiration, soft references, and event listeners. It manages cache instances, tracks hit/miss statistics, and supports cache operations such as put, get, remove, and clear.

classes.name: UtilCache
classes.description: A thread-safe, serializable cache utility supporting size limits, expiration, soft references, and event listeners. Manages cache instances and provides core cache operations.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Inserts or updates an element in the cache with optional expiration time.

methods.name: putIfAbsent
methods.description: Inserts an element only if it is not already present in the cache.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an element from the cache by key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an element from the cache by key.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all entries from the cache.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the current number of elements in the cache.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the cache.

methods.name: setExpireTime
methods.description: Sets expiration time for cache entries.

methods.name: getExpireTime
methods.description: Returns the current expiration time setting.

methods.name: setUseSoftReference
methods.description: Enables or disables soft references for cache entries.

methods.name: getUseSoftReference
methods.description: Checks if soft references are enabled.

methods.name: createUtilCache
methods.description: Factory method to create a new cache instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: findCache
methods.description: Retrieves an existing cache instance by name.
